title: The Last Sigil Revisited
author: B. M. Blackwood
blurb: Paloma Hartwell, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
